justifications.slope: A provisional mobility geometry descriptor; weight is a researcher-set prior.
justifications.local_relief: A provisional local elevation-range descriptor at the declared support.
justifications.terrain_roughness: A provisional elevation-dispersion descriptor, not traction.
justifications.landform_morphology: A low-weight relative-position class summary only.

uncertainty_method: Bootstrap standard error of feature distribution distances; it estimates finite-sample sampling variability only, not DEM measurement or instrument uncertainty.
